name: MCP Relay
description: Connect remote MCP clients to your OpenClaw Gateway

cliCommands.name: mcp-relay
cliCommands.description: Inspect the MCP relay connection and manage client grants

relayUrl.label: Relay URL
relayUrl.help: HTTPS relay origin. HTTP is supported only for localhost and 127.0.0.1 development.

agentId.label: Default Agent
agentId.help: Optional agent for new conversations; otherwise use the Gateway default.

recommendedPrompts: Help me connect ChatGPT, Codex, or Claude to this Gateway through MCP Relay. Ask which app I want to connect, explain the outbound relay and its access limits, and guide me through the supported consent flow. Explain that the relay can see traffic in transit; do not enable a connection, issue a pairing code, or grant access without my approval.

Help me review the apps connected through MCP Relay. Using only metadata I am authorized to inspect, explain each grant’s owner and access level and identify anything that deserves a closer look. Do not display pairing secrets, revoke grants, or widen an app’s permissions without asking.
